purpose: Smallest two-arm cohort that covers unresolved distance curvature and both upward- and downward-leaning shot-limited cells on the observed red/green frontier.

reused_evidence.reason: The full-grid curvature route is already resolved by audited Phase B1 data, so rerunning it would be duplicate compute.

analysis.primary: Bayesian posterior OLS linear-projection slope against code distance
analysis.prior_sensitivity: Jeffreys Beta(1/2,1/2) primary and uniform Beta(1,1) sensitivity
analysis.distance_job_pooling: Combine new L5/L13 counts with the existing audited L7/L9/L11 cohort at the same q,p.
analysis.shot_job_pooling: Combine new independent L7/L9/L11 counts with the existing 1000 shots per size at the same q,p.
analysis.claim_boundary: Update only these target cells; no interpolated boundary or asymptotic phase claim.

preflight_gate: Implement and test a non-overwriting job-specific dispatcher, completion audit, and pooled fuzzy-trend analyzer before launch.
stop_rule: Stop after three jobs and 8000 new decodes. Do not add other gray cells, q/p midpoints, square jobs, or further distances before audit and analysis.
